#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import pandas as pd

# Read the input matrix
df = pd.read_csv("outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv")

# Identify indicator columns (exclude id, name, year)
id_cols = ("city_id", "city_name", "year")
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in id_cols]

total_rows = len(df)

# Prepare missingness report
report_rows = []
kept_indicators = []

for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_cnt = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_cnt / total_rows
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    report_rows.append((col, missing_cnt, missing_rate, kept))
    if kept:
        kept_indicators.append(col)

# Create report DataFrame
report_df = pd.DataFrame(
    report_rows,
    columns=["indicator", "missing_count", "missing_rate", "kept"]
)

# Write missingness report
report_df.to_csv(
    "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv",
    quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
    index=False,
    line_terminator="\n"
)

# Prepare selected matrix with only kept indicators
selected_cols = list(id_cols) + kept_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_cols]

# Write selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv(
    "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv",
    quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
    index=False,
    line_terminator="\n"
)
</solution_file>
